senses.gloss: m. (κοντός, contus) pole, shaft of a pike; pike.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 3:3">Erub. III, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Eruvin 34b:4">34ᵇ</cite>) <he>בראש הק׳</he> Y. ed. (Mish. a. Bab. ed. <cite ref="D00000"><he>ד</he></cite> for <cite ref="I00000"><he>ט</he></cite>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10) on the top of a pole (which is stuck in the ground); Y. ib. 21ᵃ.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:12:3">Y. Taan. II, 66ᵃ</cite> top <he>ותליין בק׳ נגד וכ׳</he> and he suspended them (Nicanor’s head and hands) on a pike put up in the sight of Jerusalem; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:4:10">Y. Meg. I, 70ᶜ</cite> bot.; a. e.—Pl. <he>קוֹנְטוֹסִים</he>, <he>קוֹנְטוֹסִין</he>, <cite ref="S00428"><he>קוֹנְטָסִ׳</he></cite> (<he>קוֹנְדּ׳</he>).

<cite ref="Sukkah 4b:6">Succ. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>נעץ ארבעה קונדיסין וכ׳</he> if one drove four poles in the ground and put the covering of a Succah on them; (Tosef. ib. I, 12 <he>העמיד … קורות</he>). Pesik. Vayhi, p. 4ᵇ <he>היה לו … קינטיסין וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) he might have taken four poles and spread &c.; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:11:2">Cant. R. to III, 11</cite> <he>קונדסין</he>; Yalk. Ex. 370 <he>קונדיסין</he>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:13">Num. R. s. 4</cite> <he>קונטיטון … וצינורות וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) large shafts with hooks on top; <he>והיו מגביהין … בק׳ וכ׳</he> and they lifted the curtain on the poles and unhooked it.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:13">Ib.</cite> <he>נושאים … בקונטיטון</he> (some ed. <he>בקונטיס׳</he>; corr. acc.) lifted it on poles.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 12">Pesik. R. s. 12</cite> <he>קבע … קונדיסים וכ׳</he> he fixed four pikes in the ground &c.; Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 9 <he>קנטסין</he>; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3">Lam. R. to III, 64</cite> <he>קונדיס׳</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 938:30">Yalk. Deut. 938</cite>.
